_doc: Story lexicon for coverage.py: every narration word found here must be shown on screen at its word. verbs -> the poses/actions that act it out and the props whose file names prove it; nouns -> the file-name words that prove the object is on screen; people are covered by characters on screen; generic verbs are ignored. Extend freely.
